dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you looking for this?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (Inside the nest lie scattered scraps of paper, with what looks like broken lines of handwriting still visible on them...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did they tear up all this paper for nesting material?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's writing on it too. Maybe we should piece it together and see what it says?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Guess we'll have to do it ourselves...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, aren't you at least a little curious? What if it's a treasure map?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After Paimon's repeated prodding, the scraps are finally assembled...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, moment of truth... This is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... No way... Is this some kind of crime plan!?

choices.text: What kind of criminal mastermind loses their plan to a bird!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: H-Hey, that kind of thing happens in novels all the time! A perfectly foolproof plan that falls apart because of the one thing nobody expected...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's check the nearby tavern and see if anyone's heard rumors about someone "planning a crime" lately...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y-Yeah! Exactly... What if someone really is plotting something? If we ignore it and something happens, it'll be too late to fix it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I found it in a bird's nest...

dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: Th-This... That's my crime plan!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! He actually just admitted it!

dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: No, no! Please don't misunderstand! It's just a plot idea for my next novel. I came up with it while I was drinking and wrote it down.

dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: When I woke up and the page was gone, I thought it was just a drunken dream.

dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: Anyway, thank you so much for helping me find it. Now my novel can finally move forward. I'll send you a signed copy when it's out!

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Oh? Let me see. Hmm... The concept's not bad. I'd give the creativity a six out of ten. As for practicality... maybe a four.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I-Is this a crime plan?

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Haha. Funny enough, I came over from the base because I heard rumors that someone around here was plotting some strange "master plan."

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: ...But after reading this note, I think I understand how those rumors got started.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: I'll hand this over to the Knights just in case. And if you're free later, stop by my base. You might catch something worth watching.

dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: ...Sir Knight! I swear, it's just a plot point for a novel! It wasn't a "master plan" for a crime or anything.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: I understand, Mr. Uchida, I hear you loud and clear. No need to get so worked up. Why don't you have some tea and calm down first?

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: According to intel from a key informant... your manuscript really doesn't look like a "master plan" for a crime. After all, it would be extremely impractical to pull off.

dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: Excuse me!? What do you mean "impractical"!? If you're so brilliant, tell me what's wrong!

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Too many conditions, and the steps are far too convoluted. You'd need a poison that fits your exact needs, not to mention a building that matches your specific requirements...

dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: Uhhh...

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: One tiny slip at any stage and the whole thing will be exposed instantly, won't it? Not to mention, the setup is so convoluted that it's a chore just understanding it all.

dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: ...Now that you mention it, you do have a point. In that case, how should I improve this?

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: I suppose I do dabble in medicine from time to time. How about we try a bit of this... and then... a little of that?

dialogues.speaker: Uchida Kotaro
dialogues.text: Oh! Honestly, Sir Knight, this job is beneath you! You're far too brilliant!
